title: 第二十五章王爸 优势在我这波能赢新书求推荐票求月票求收藏第二十六章王璃 我真是太难了新书求推荐票求月票求收藏
slug: 这年头谁还不是个武者啊
content_zh:
第二十五章王爸：优势在我，这波能赢！
【新书，求推荐票，求月票，求收藏】
“我满脑子到底在想着些什么呢！
这笑声像鸭子的黑袍人，怎么也不可能是我家那个不着调的大儿子啊。”
不是王爸不喜欢自家大儿子，但就大儿子他那样的武道资质。
不是王爸自己吹嘘自己，但再给大儿子二十年的时间，王爸都怀疑他能不得达到自己现在的程度。
有些时候啊，武道资质这种东西，是真的不能不认。
就好比他的那两只小的，王爸就从来不怀疑他们有能成为“武者”
的可能。
不过话又说回来，大儿子他武道什么的放到一边，但在别的方面可是远远超过自己。
他也用不着王爸来替他操心。
毕竟有的是人愿意来养他。
别以为那不着调的大儿子，背着自己偷偷在李元竹家，还有其他几个人家干的那些事情他不知道。
老父亲永远……都在默默的注视着他。
反正王爸是觉得，大儿子哪天被直接五等分了都一点不奇怪。
以后，不要说让他来接济接济弟弟妹妹了，能不把自己屋顶给直接掀飞了，王爸就要谢天谢地了。
“等等，都这个关头了，我脑子里怎么还想着那個不着调的儿子。”
事实证明，王璃果然是王爸的种。
至少，这种一言不合就头脑风暴，精神散发的一脉相承的行为，一般家庭还真学不来。
“嘎嘎嘎嘎～～”

也就在王爸稍微愣神的刹那，那黑袍人人未到，声音就已经率先传开，仅眨眼的功夫，就已经来到他面前。
王爸瞬间紧醒，赶紧把“这厮挺像我儿子”
这种极度不正常的想法抛之脑后。
“黑武者？”
王爸似试探的询问了一声，又缓缓站起身来。
“混元内力”
在他的身体里剧烈鼓噪不休，在他的衣服上鼓动起一个又一个小漩涡，宛如一个被极限压下的弹簧，就等骤然爆发的那一瞬。
事实上在大汉联邦里，“黑武者”
的范畴其实非常广。
不仅是那些信仰邪神，崇拜邪祟，移植蛮血，彻底背弃本身世界，为了力量而投身到另一个世界，另一个文明的武人。
如修炼邪功魔功，以血祭血身等背弃人类准则，乃至是不惜一切代价，只为突破武道境界，从而丧失身为一位“人”
所应该的道德操守的武人，也都是直接归于“黑武者”
的范畴。
大汉联邦早有成文法规，发现一位黑武者，若是能直接打死。
其人不仅不会负任何的法律责任，更可以得到大汉联邦真金白银的奖励！
就像王爸现在身前摆放的，那几乎是王家农家乐几十年身价的“一转白阳丹”
只要他能打死一个黑武者，哪怕只是武徒层次，也起码能换到五枚以上！
但生物不断向上进化的本能，是无可阻挡的，即使大汉联邦已经如此严防死守，可是投身入“黑武者”
行列的武人，依旧络绎不绝。
content_en:
Chapter 25: Dad Wang: I have the advantage, I can win this wave!
[New book, please vote for recommendations, monthly votes, and favorites]
"What the hell is going on in my head!
This man in black robes who laughs like a duck can't possibly be the inconspicuous eldest son of my family. "
It's not that Father Wang doesn't like his eldest son, but he has such martial arts qualifications.
It's not that Father Wang is bragging about himself, but if his eldest son is given another twenty years, Father Wang will doubt whether he will be able to reach his current level.
Sometimes, martial arts qualifications are something that you really have to recognize.
Just like his two little ones, Father Wang never doubted their ability to become "warriors"
possible.
But then again, the eldest son puts his martial arts aside, but in other aspects he far surpasses himself.
He doesn't need Father Wang to worry about him.
After all, there are people willing to support him.
Don't think that the obscure eldest son doesn't know what he did secretly at Li Yuanzhu's house and several other families behind his back.
The old father was always watching him silently.
Anyway, Father Wang felt that it would not be surprising at all for his eldest son to be cut into five equal parts one day.
From now on, let alone asking him to help his younger brothers and sisters, Father Wang will be thankful if his roof is not blown off.
"Wait a minute, it's already at this juncture, why am I still thinking about that obscure son?"
Facts have proved that Wang Li is indeed Father Wang's son.
At least, ordinary families really can’t learn this kind of consistent behavior of brainstorming and radiating spirit whenever they disagree.
“Quack, quack, quack~~”
At the moment when Father Wang was slightly dazed, the voice of the black-robed man had already spread before anyone arrived, and in just the blink of an eye, he was in front of him.
Father Wang woke up instantly and quickly said, "This guy looks like my son."
This extremely abnormal thought was thrown away.
"Dark Warrior?"
Father Wang asked tentatively, then stood up slowly.
"Hunyuan Inner Power"
There was a violent roar in his body, and small whirlpools were stirred up on his clothes, like a spring that was pressed to the limit, just waiting for the moment to suddenly explode.
In fact, in the Han Federation, the "Black Warrior"
The scope is actually very broad.
Not only those warriors who believe in evil gods, worship evil spirits, transplant barbarian blood, completely abandon their own world, and join another world and another civilization for the sake of power.
Such as practicing evil arts and demonic arts, sacrificing blood to the body, etc. and betraying human principles, or even doing whatever it takes just to break through the realm of martial arts, thereby losing one's identity as a "human"
The moral integrity a warrior should have is directly attributed to the "black warrior"
category.
The Han Federation has already written laws and regulations. If a black warrior is found, he can be killed directly.
Not only will he not bear any legal responsibility, he will also be rewarded with real money and silver from the Han Federation!
Just like what Dad Wang is placing in front of him now, it is almost the "Yi Zhuan Baiyang Pill" that Wang Family Farmhouse has been worth for decades.
As long as he can kill a black warrior, even if he is only at the warrior level, he can get at least five more!
However, the instinct of living things to continuously evolve is unstoppable. Even though the Han Federation has been so tight on defense, it has yet to join the ranks of the "Black Warriors"
There is still an endless stream of warriors in the ranks.
